data.name: Thia
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Thia was the goddess of fertility and prosperity. The name Thia is derived from the Greek word théos, meaning 'god' or 'divine'.

in_hebrew.name: תיא
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word תיא (Tiyah) which means 'goddess', derived from the Hebrew word אל (El) meaning 'God'. This name was used in ancient times for a goddess of fertility and abundance.

in_greek.name: Θεια
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word Θεια (Theia) which means 'goddess', derived from the Greek word Θεος (Theos) meaning 'God'. In Greek mythology, Theia was one of the Titanesses, the elder generation of major deities who preceded the Olympians.

in_latin.name: Theia
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word Theia, derived from the Greek word Θεια (Theia), meaning 'goddess'. In Roman mythology, Theia was associated with the cult of Venus, the goddess of love and beauty.

in_english.name: Thia
in_english.long_meaning: From the Greek word Θεια (Theia), meaning 'goddess'. The name Thia is derived from the Greek word Θεος (Theos), meaning 'God'.
